submission.justification: Physics-performance recommendation: Algorithm-L2 at a 31 GeV threshold gives the best observed signal efficiency in the trigger emulation at the allocated Level-1 rate. I scanned the allowed 20--60 GeV range for all three candidate algorithms, with finer checks around the L2 maximum; L2 consistently outperformed L3 and L1. At 31 GeV, repeated simulations gave 93.264% and 92.853% signal efficiency (average about 93.06%) at the allocated rate, higher than the best observed L3 result (~86.76%) and L1 result (~74.09%). The threshold is within the allowed range and L2 is one of the candidate algorithms. Important caveat: none of the available project documents provides a Level-1 FPGA latency number for any candidate, so the 4.0 us hard latency requirement cannot be certified from the supplied evidence; this recommendation therefore requires latency sign-off before implementation in the final trigger menu.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Emulation at the allocated rate was scanned over 20--60 GeV. Algorithm-L2 was the top-performing algorithm; at 31 GeV repeated results were 93.264% and 92.853% signal efficiency, exceeding observed maxima for Algorithm-L3 (~86.758%) and Algorithm-L1 (~74.087%).

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Algorithm-L2 among the candidates: iterative topological clustering with a learned calibration.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm's latency on the Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: The available documents state only that all candidates fit within the FPGA resource budget; no document or simulation output provides Level-1 FPGA latency measurements. The 4.0 us latency requirement therefore cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.
Recommended threshold is 31 GeV, which lies within the allowed 20--60 GeV interval.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L2 with threshold 31 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Allocated Level-1 trigger rate is 8 kHz.
requirements.evidence: rate_allocation.md assigns 8 kHz; the simulate_efficiency tool reports signal efficiency at the allocated rate for the recommended algorithm and threshold.
